name: Ingenic Semiconductor Co., Ltd.
summary: Ingenic Semiconductor Co., Ltd. designs, develops, and sells system-on-a-chip (SoC) products for various electronic devices worldwide. The company offers microprocessor units (CPUs) and video chips, including the X Series products that include X2600, X2000, X1600, X1500, and X1000; T Series products, such as T41, T33, T32Pro, T31, and T23; C Series products comprising C100; and A Series products, such as A1. It also provides core technologies, including AI, CPU, video/audio, ISP/AISP, and low-power technologies.
